name: Telegram Bulk Username Profile Check
description: User id, last-seen time, active days, member flag and avatar URL for a whole list of usernames.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether the username belongs to an existing Telegram account.

result_fields.name: lastseen
result_fields.description: The most recent online time observed.

result_fields.name: activedays
result_fields.description: Days since that activity — smaller is more recent.

result_fields.name: member
result_fields.description: Whether the account has Telegram Premium.

result_fields.name: avatar_url
result_fields.description: Avatar URL, empty when the account has none.
